title: RTC+B is operating
recordType: Analyst-authored paraphrase; original page is not archived
claim: ERCOT confirmed the December 5, 2025 RTC+B operating day, with joint real-time clearing of energy and ancillary services.
supports: Market-design context for evaluating storage revenue.
missing: Does not establish this project's revenues, dispatch, or achievable prices.

title: Large-load forecasts include adjustments
recordType: Analyst-authored paraphrase; original page is not archived
claim: ERCOT's forecast page separately lists transmission-service-provider forecasts and ERCOT-adjusted hourly forecasts, including large-load adjustments.
supports: Testing alternative load-growth scenarios rather than equating requests with realized demand.
missing: Does not establish the demo's 60% realization assumption or its assumed relationship to prices.

title: Project economics are synthetic
claim: Bluebonnet is a fictional 100 MW / 200 MWh battery: $55m capex, $180/MWh discharge price, $35/MWh charging price, $1.2m annual ancillary revenue and $1.6m annual operating cost. Assumptions include one cycle daily, 93% availability, 86% round-trip efficiency and 2% annual degradation.
supports: Reproducible illustrative calculations; not an actual deal or quoted market price.
missing: No commercial bids, operating data, site studies, financing terms, or investment mandate.

title: Decision rule and model boundaries
claim: Advance only when 15-year unlevered pre-tax NPV at 10% is nonnegative and IRR is at least 12%. Discharge price changes by $0.60/MWh per percentage-point change in load realization relative to 60%; this is a hypothetical sensitivity, not an estimated causal relationship. Capex is paid now; operating delay shifts all annual cash flows.
supports: A transparent screening rule for sensitivity exploration.
missing: Excludes tax, debt, augmentation, congestion, curtailment and dispatch optimization. Revenue stacking, insurance, degradation and timing require commercial validation.
